The LAC (N/W)

after completing all the requisite formalities as provided under the Act, announced the Award bearing no.08 of 200506 dated 12.07.2005 u/s 11 of the Act in respect of 907 bighas 09 biswas out of the aforesaid said land and awarded a compensation at the uniform rate of Rs.15,70,000/ per acre (or Rs. 3,27,083.33/ per bigha) for the entire said land in addition to other statutory benefits and interests besides liquidated cost for trees, tubewell and borings.

4. It is stated that the petitioner was the recorded owner/bhumidhar in possession of full share in the land bearing Khasra no. 46//9 min (019), 10 min (003) total land admeasuring 01 Bigha 02 Biswas situated in the revenue estate of Village Rani Khera, Delhi (in short, the said land).
5. It is stated that the petitioner is entitled to receive the compensation amount of the actual prevailing market value of the said land.
The actual physical possession of the said land is with the petitioner as the physical possession of the land has not been taken and the respondents shall take possession thereof from the petitioner.

The LAC passed the award in a mechanical way without applying the mind and without going through the LAC no. 385/ 2016 (Award No. 08/2005 06/DC(NW)) Jai Narain v. Union of India Page no. 3 of 11 claim filed by the petitioner, as such the award is not acceptable to the petitioner, and she has received the awarded amount under protest and without prejudice to their rights.
